exposure: UtA pulsatility index (UtA-PI) at 30-34 week's gestation
Uterine artery pulsatility index (UtA-PI) at 30-34 weeks' gestation
outcome: Low umbilical arterial cord blood pH
Admission to Intensive Care Unit in the first 3 days of birth
finding: Although the incidence of some adverse perinatal outcomes was higher in pregnant women with high UtA-PI compared to those with normal UtA-PI, this factor alone could not properly predict adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: While the incidence of some adverse perinatal outcomes was higher in pregnant women with high UtA-PI compared to those with normal UtA-PI, this factor alone could not properly predict adverse perinatal outcome.
